description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'DefinitionIdentifierInvalidException' used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides mechanisms to instantiate the exception with various details and includes a builder class to create immutable instances. The exception signals invalid structure in feature definition identifiers, adhering to a specific format.
